summary: Postinstall downloads and executes binary from a GitHub org unrelated to the declared publisher
details: On `npm install`, install.js downloads a platform-specific binary from https://github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot/releases/download/v<VERSION>/<asset>, writes it to bin/apex with mode 0755, and apex.js spawns it as the package's CLI. The fetched bytes are not hash-pinned or signature-verified. The package's own metadata (repository, homepage, bugs) points to can1357/oh-my-pi with homepage omp.sh, and the shipped README is for `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent`, but the package is published under a different scope (`@apexfdn/apex`) and the binary is pulled from an unrelated `Apex-Foundation/copilot` org. Installing the package therefore executes arbitrary code controlled by whoever owns the Apex-Foundation GitHub org, under the guise of the omp coding agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
